# Giant clam, phase 1: blockout with its materials (the interior is coloured before its extrude, the
# ribs before the lift: exact BLK AQU4 colours).  Up Z, facing -Y, hinge at the back (+Y). Generated by make_p1.py.
# Lower shell: a 10-sided bowl 2.0 x 1.64 x 0.5, bottom ring at 0.7, hollowed (mantle inside), five
# zig-zag teeth on the rim. Upper shell: the same bowl turned over, the same tapered bowl upside down
# (its dome poked into a low fan), lifted 30 degrees about the hinge (0, 0.82, 0.5).
new
material new Shell --base-color 0.0 0.725 0.745 --no-slot
material new Groove --base-color 0.0 0.373 0.549 --no-slot
material new Mantle --base-color 0.0 0.169 0.349 --no-slot
material new Pearl --base-color 0.624 0.957 0.898 --emission 0.624 0.957 0.898 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Lower --vertices 10 --radius 1.05 --depth 0.5 --location 0 0 0 --rotation 0 0 18
apply --rotation
scale 1 0.82 1
apply --scale
material assign Shell
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.z) < 0.9 && ((abs(normal.x/sqrt(normal.x*normal.x + normal.y*normal.y/1.0000) - (1.000)) < 0.15 && abs(normal.y/1.0/sqrt(normal.x*normal.x + normal.y*normal.y/1.0000) - (0.000)) < 0.15) || (abs(normal.x/sqrt(normal.x*normal.x + normal.y*normal.y/1.0000) - (0.309)) < 0.15 && abs(normal.y/1.0/sqrt(normal.x*normal.x + normal.y*normal.y/1.0000) - (0.951)) < 0.15) || (abs(normal.x/sqrt(normal.x*normal.x + normal.y*normal.y/1.0000) - (-0.809)) < 0.15 && abs(normal.y/1.0/sqrt(normal.x*normal.x + normal.y*normal.y/1.0000) - (0.588)) < 0.15) || (abs(normal.x/sqrt(normal.x*normal.x + normal.y*normal.y/1.0000) - (-0.809)) < 0.15 && abs(normal.y/1.0/sqrt(normal.x*normal.x + normal.y*normal.y/1.0000) - (-0.588)) < 0.15) || (abs(normal.x/sqrt(normal.x*normal.x + normal.y*normal.y/1.0000) - (0.309)) < 0.15 && abs(normal.y/1.0/sqrt(normal.x*normal.x + normal.y*normal.y/1.0000) - (-0.951)) < 0.15))"
material assign Groove
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
scale 0.7 0.7 1
poke
select vert where "pos.z < -0.2 && abs(pos.x) < 0.01 && abs(pos.y) < 0.01"
translate 0 0 -0.06
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
inset 0.09
material assign Mantle
extrude 0 0 -0.32
select face where "abs(normal.z) < 0.9 && normal.x*pos.x + normal.y*pos.y < 0"
material assign Mantle
select vert where "pos.z > 0.2 && ((abs(pos.x/sqrt(pos.x*pos.x + pos.y*pos.y/0.6724) - (0.588)) < 0.1 && abs(pos.y/0.82/sqrt(pos.x*pos.x + pos.y*pos.y/0.6724) - (0.809)) < 0.1) || (abs(pos.x/sqrt(pos.x*pos.x + pos.y*pos.y/0.6724) - (-0.588)) < 0.1 && abs(pos.y/0.82/sqrt(pos.x*pos.x + pos.y*pos.y/0.6724) - (0.809)) < 0.1) || (abs(pos.x/sqrt(pos.x*pos.x + pos.y*pos.y/0.6724) - (-0.951)) < 0.1 && abs(pos.y/0.82/sqrt(pos.x*pos.x + pos.y*pos.y/0.6724) - (-0.309)) < 0.1) || (abs(pos.x/sqrt(pos.x*pos.x + pos.y*pos.y/0.6724) - (-0.000)) < 0.1 && abs(pos.y/0.82/sqrt(pos.x*pos.x + pos.y*pos.y/0.6724) - (-1.000)) < 0.1) || (abs(pos.x/sqrt(pos.x*pos.x + pos.y*pos.y/0.6724) - (0.951)) < 0.1 && abs(pos.y/0.82/sqrt(pos.x*pos.x + pos.y*pos.y/0.6724) - (-0.309)) < 0.1))"
translate 0 0 0.12
mode object
set location 0 0 0.25
apply --location
add mesh cylinder --name Upper --vertices 10 --radius 1.05 --depth 0.45 --location 0 0 0 --rotation 0 0 18
apply --rotation
scale 1 0.8 1
apply --scale
material assign Shell
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.z) < 0.9 && ((abs(normal.x/sqrt(normal.x*normal.x + normal.y*normal.y/1.0000) - (1.000)) < 0.15 && abs(normal.y/1.0/sqrt(normal.x*normal.x + normal.y*normal.y/1.0000) - (0.000)) < 0.15) || (abs(normal.x/sqrt(normal.x*normal.x + normal.y*normal.y/1.0000) - (0.309)) < 0.15 && abs(normal.y/1.0/sqrt(normal.x*normal.x + normal.y*normal.y/1.0000) - (0.951)) < 0.15) || (abs(normal.x/sqrt(normal.x*normal.x + normal.y*normal.y/1.0000) - (-0.809)) < 0.15 && abs(normal.y/1.0/sqrt(normal.x*normal.x + normal.y*normal.y/1.0000) - (0.588)) < 0.15) || (abs(normal.x/sqrt(normal.x*normal.x + normal.y*normal.y/1.0000) - (-0.809)) < 0.15 && abs(normal.y/1.0/sqrt(normal.x*normal.x + normal.y*normal.y/1.0000) - (-0.588)) < 0.15) || (abs(normal.x/sqrt(normal.x*normal.x + normal.y*normal.y/1.0000) - (0.309)) < 0.15 && abs(normal.y/1.0/sqrt(normal.x*normal.x + normal.y*normal.y/1.0000) - (-0.951)) < 0.15))"
material assign Groove
# the dome (outer face, up while closed): narrowed and poked into a low fan
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
scale 0.7 0.7 1
poke
select vert where "pos.z > 0.2 && abs(pos.x) < 0.01 && abs(pos.y) < 0.01"
translate 0 0.15 0.08
# the rim (down while closed): hollowed, teeth pointing down
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
inset 0.09
material assign Groove
extrude 0 0 0.28
select face where "abs(normal.z) < 0.9 && normal.x*pos.x + normal.y*pos.y < 0"
material assign Groove
select vert where "pos.z < -0.2 && ((abs(pos.x/sqrt(pos.x*pos.x + pos.y*pos.y/0.6400) - (0.588)) < 0.1 && abs(pos.y/0.8/sqrt(pos.x*pos.x + pos.y*pos.y/0.6400) - (0.809)) < 0.1) || (abs(pos.x/sqrt(pos.x*pos.x + pos.y*pos.y/0.6400) - (-0.588)) < 0.1 && abs(pos.y/0.8/sqrt(pos.x*pos.x + pos.y*pos.y/0.6400) - (0.809)) < 0.1) || (abs(pos.x/sqrt(pos.x*pos.x + pos.y*pos.y/0.6400) - (-0.951)) < 0.1 && abs(pos.y/0.8/sqrt(pos.x*pos.x + pos.y*pos.y/0.6400) - (-0.309)) < 0.1) || (abs(pos.x/sqrt(pos.x*pos.x + pos.y*pos.y/0.6400) - (-0.000)) < 0.1 && abs(pos.y/0.8/sqrt(pos.x*pos.x + pos.y*pos.y/0.6400) - (-1.000)) < 0.1) || (abs(pos.x/sqrt(pos.x*pos.x + pos.y*pos.y/0.6400) - (0.951)) < 0.1 && abs(pos.y/0.8/sqrt(pos.x*pos.x + pos.y*pos.y/0.6400) - (-0.309)) < 0.1))"
translate 0 0 -0.12
mode object
# hinge: the upper shell's back edge on the lower one's back edge, then lifted about it
set location 0 0 0.725
apply --location
cursor set 0 0.82 0.5
origin set --to cursor
set rotation -30 0 0
apply --rotation
add mesh ico-sphere --name Pearl --subdivisions 2 --radius 0.21 --location 0 -0.05 0.62
material assign Pearl
